parameters.note: Tahoe-tributary check (required for Tahoe-basin waters): North Miller Creek (Placer Co.) is a small headwater stream that descends south/southwest and joins the head of Miller Creek (they share their junction node in OpenStreetMap, ~39.0352, -120.2180). Miller Creek flows west to the Rubicon River, a major tributary of the Middle Fork American River; USGS elevations confirm the reach drops steadily westward, below Lake Tahoe's surface. North Miller Creek therefore drains to the American River, NOT into Lake Tahoe, and is NOT a Lake Tahoe tributary — so the §7.50(b)(152) 'Tahoe Lake tributaries' special closure does NOT apply. It is not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b). Consistent with its receiving waters Miller Creek and the Rubicon River (both treated here under the general stream regulation), it falls under the general statewide stream regulation §5.85(a)(2): open with a five-trout bag from the last Saturday in April through November 15, then a zero-trout catch-and-release period with gear restrictions from November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April.

end.verbatim: the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April

candidates.summary: Open the last Saturday in April through November 15 (general statewide stream regulation — drains west via Miller Creek to the Rubicon River, not a Lake Tahoe tributary, so the §7.50(b)(152) Tahoe closure does not apply); November 16 through the Friday preceding the last Saturday in April is a zero-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks period
